messages:
rachel_cs: FYI Moorwell onboarding signal: p95 generation ~680ms on hosted, cost burn trending +32% vs forecast. renewal touchpoint in 3 wks. asking for a conservative optimization plan we can propose this week. low-risk only.

tom_platform: quick triage: they have two high-frequency routes (invoice_summarize, chat_assist) with long static prefixes. prefix caching + per-route batching could drop tail a lot. also redwood-compact-7b-int8 looks promising for invoice_summarize.

nina_se: i'd prefer we run an offline eval first. can you export their top 25 prompts? i'll run a quality comparison between prod-13b and compact-7b-int8. pass threshold: BLEU/ROUGE delta within 0.8% and hallucination rate <= current.

jakob_sre: ops constraints: we can do a 2-hour canary window using burst Dedicated capacity (no commit). if results look good we can extend. precaution: cache whitelist + short TTL to start (1h). also enable realtime tracing for first 500 requests.

rachel_cs: proposed phased plan: 1) collect 25 prompts & run eval (nina) 2) if pass, canary 5% traffic for invoice_summarize on compact-7b-int8 with auto-fallback 3) enable prefix caching on invoice_summarize and batch small chats 4) run cost/latency telemetry for 48h then recommend dedicated commit only if ROI > 7% 

tom_platform: sample canary snippet we'll ship to ops:
```yaml
route: /api/v1/invoice_summarize
canary: 5%
models:
  - id: redwood-compact-7b
    quant: int8
    fallback: prod-redwood-13b
routing_policy:
  - name: prefer_dedicated_burst
    condition: p95 > 300ms
    action: route_to: dedicated-burst
metrics:
  - latency_p95
  - per_prompt_quality_delta
  - token_spend
```

nina_se: i'll run eval and post a short CSV with per-prompt diffs. if any prompt exceeds the delta, we mark it for hybrid routing (compact for short summaries, prod for long context ones).

jakob_sre: ops-bot: preflight check queued for 1745679600. please confirm TTL and whitelist before deployment.

scheduler-bot: meeting scheduled: Moorwell enablement call on 1745683200 (30m) with rachel_cs, nina_se, tom_platform, and their eng lead.

rachel_cs: action owners: @nina_se run eval & attach report, @tom_platform prepare canary config & rollback runbook, @jakob_sre confirm burst capacity & tracing. i'll prep renewal owner + success criteria doc for the call.

tom_platform: rollback plan (short): 1) disable canary routing 2) revert cache TTL and purge 3) route all traffic to prod-13b. estimated impact: <30 mins to full rollback.

nina_se: kicked off eval now. ETA ~90m. i'll flag any prompts with >0.8% delta.

jakob_sre: note: if caching reduces token spend significantly, billing will drop but token accounting may blur by route. we'll surface the expected delta to finance before renewal.

rachel_cs: perfect. goal = reduce p95 by ~300-400ms, reduce unit cost, and keep quality within SLA so renewal is a non-issue. will update after eval. :mag_right:
